stops.detail: Sabinares del Arlanza- La Yecla is a natural park in Castile and León, Spain. It is located in the province of Burgos, very close to the Natural Park of the Canyon of the River Lobos. It has an area of 39 173 hectares and affects the regions of Arlanza and Sierra de la Demanda. It was established by LEY 4 / [dated source] of 14 December.)
